📖 How to use

  1. Enter your 5K goal time in minutes and seconds.
  2. Read your required pace per km and per mile.
  3. Follow the km-by-km split table on race day.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a good 5K time?

Beginners often run 30-35 minutes; regular runners 22-28; competitive club runners go sub-20. Your first goal should be beating your own best.

How do I hit these splits?

Practice goal pace in training with intervals (e.g. 5 × 1 km at goal pace). Start the race slightly conservatively.

Why is the mile pace slower than the km pace number?

A mile (1.609 km) is longer than a kilometer, so it takes more time at the same speed.
